edge_exposure.distance_method: distance from each record to the boundary of ITS OWN NUTS-3 polygon, in a per-polygon local metric frame (x = lon * 111320 * cos(polygon centroid latitude), y = lat * 110540). NOT geodesic; a raw EPSG:4326 distance would overstate east-west offsets by 1/cos(lat). Immaterial to a 100 m / 500 m / 1 km screen and not to be quoted to the metre.
edge_exposure.layer_positional_accuracy: NOT STATED ANYWHERE THE ESTATE HOLDS
edge_exposure.why_that_matters: whether the records nearest an edge are actually misassigned depends on the layer's positional accuracy and on each record's coordinate precision. The scale is stated and the accuracy is not, and converting a map scale into a ground tolerance needs the publisher's own statement rather than a cartographic convention applied by us. So these counts are a measured population with an unmeasurable risk, and the figure that would close it belongs to Eurostat.
edge_exposure.not_a_defect: ZERO of the 40793 assigned records lie outside the polygon they were assigned to, zero units carry more than one C, and zero C units lack a polygon. Nothing is reassigned and nothing should be: preferring a neighbour on a distance heuristic would create a defect where measurement found none.
edge_exposure.not_a_withdrawal: No component, metric, score, band or _cprov is affected. Measuring how much of a record is known is not a reason to publish less of it.
edge_exposure.the_declared_absences_are_already_here: placed, left_alone_outside_polygons and left_alone_in_a_neighbour_country on this same entry are the Convention #56 record of the join, written when it was applied in August 2026. This note adds the boundary residual of the records that WERE placed; it does not restate those.
edge_exposure.compared_with_the_uks_key: the uk's C key is a DNO licence area: 14 units over 59,130 records, 0.23% within 100 m of an edge, median wrong-side cost 0.3945. italy's is 104 units, 0.88% within 100 m, median cost 0.1211. A finer partition puts MORE records near an edge and makes the neighbours' values CLOSER; the expected error per record comes out within 18%. Granularity redistributes boundary error, it does not remove it.

component_swaps.declaration: V = N(V1_total x (1 + 0.50 x V2_severe_ratio)) per doctrine/METHOD_the_V_mosaic.md. V1_total and V2_severe both from Banca d'Italia QEF 737 Tavola 13, anno 2019, the populated EN 50160 grid, Fonte: Sistema QuEEN (RSE) -- ONE publication, ONE vintage, ONE population, so the ratio is computed without mixing sources. Parsed from data/e_metrics/qef737_extract.txt and every grid verified against the document's own printed total. V2_severe is the bands at residual <= 40%, 5...40 and 1...5. Five territorial units: Centro-Nord and Mezzogiorno (ISTAT ripartizioni, Sud + Isole) at macro-area, and Trentino-Alto Adige, Toscana and Basilicata at region, finest first. No interpolation between units. ARERA N3b 2024 is NOT used: different vintage, unit and population. Method B over italy's own fleet. SUPERSEDES scripts/ssi_derive_component_V.py, which computes C1_saidi x V_socio and asserts severity-weighted voltage.

component_swaps.declaration: T = T1 per INTRA_WEIGHTS['T'] = {T1: 1.00}. T1 = 0.50*N(DER_ratio) + 0.30*N(DER_variability) + 0.20*N(EV_load_ratio); only DER_ratio is present, so T1 = N(DER_ratio) and nothing is scaled. DER_ratio = distributed generation gross production (GWh) over total electricity consumption (GWh), per regione, 2024: ARERA 506/2024/I/EEL Figura 2.10 (sha256 in data/t_metrics/arera_gd_extract.txt, 20 regions summing to the document's printed 68,514.5 GWh) over Terna Dati Statistici 2024 Tabella 45 (data/s_metrics/terna_consumi_2024_tabella45.csv, 107 provinces summed UP to region, which is exact). Both 2024. National check 68,514.4/286,925.0 = 0.2388. EV_load_ratio DECLARED ABSENT -- ACI's open-data endpoint did not answer. DER_variability DECLARED ABSENT and has no published source; a technology-mix proxy would need a Pin 14 ruling and was not taken. Intra-coverage 0.50 declared on every record as _T_coverage, carried into composite_coverage_intra. Method B over the 20 published regions. DOES NOT read the `transition` block, which on italy is vary(base, name, spread) at r = 1.000.
component_swaps.note: components.T swapped from the name hash. No band or score touched here.
component_swaps.correction: CORRECTED 5 October 2026, after this declaration landed. The sentence above giving ACI's unanswered endpoint as the reason EV_load_ratio is absent is WITHDRAWN. The reason is that EV_load_ratio's declared quantity is 'EV charging load / substation capacity' (IEA Global EV Outlook 2024, via enrich_esg_gaps.py:127-143) and NO CAPACITY FIELD EXISTS ON ANY RECORD IN ANY FLEET: 219 fields over 39 fleets and 622,104 records, measured against doctrine/FIELD_PROVENANCE.yaml (P15-F-1). ACI's per-provincia vehicle counts would have supplied a numerator with nowhere to divide it, so reachability was never the obstacle. THE DECLARED INTRA-COVERAGE OF 0.50 IS UNCHANGED AND WAS CORRECT -- it is route 2's ceiling, not a shortfall against 0.70 -- and the remaining 0.20 of T1 needs a DEFINITION change, a Constitution §8 amendment, worth 0.01 of the composite on one fleet. No value, coverage figure, score or band is touched by this correction. doctrine/FINDING_EV_load_ratio_has_no_denominator_in_the_estate.md

component_swaps.declaration: derived per INTRA_WEIGHTS['I'] over the metrics this fleet carries: I1,I2,I3,I4,I5,I6, intra-coverage 0.72, renormalised over the present set. I7,I8,I9 are DECLARED ABSENT. I7, I8 and I9 are stored on NO record in the estate. Every present metric is `implemented` in doctrine/METRIC_REGISTRY.yaml and entered in doctrine/METRIC_PROVENANCE.yaml (P15-M-1). The sweep (doctrine/EVIDENCE_provenance_sweep_20261005.json) records none of them nor their raw inputs as FABRICATED on this fleet, while components.I IS fabricated here -- so this replaces a name hash with measurements. Intra-coverage is declared on every record as _I_coverage and rolled into composite_coverage_intra, because composite_coverage is COMPONENT-level per Convention #21 and would otherwise credit I's full 0.25 silently. The 0.45 floor is the flag officer's D-16 ruling of 5 October 2026.

meta.composite_coverage_intra_legend: the summed COMPONENT_WEIGHTS of the components _cprov marks L, each scaled by that component's own declared intra-coverage (_<K>_coverage), else the share of INTRA_WEIGHTS[K] whose metrics are on the record, else 1.0. composite_coverage is COMPONENT-level per Convention #21 and is unchanged; this says how much of each component's own definition stands behind it. A completeness claim, explicitly NOT a truth claim.

_S1_legend.kpi: Dimovski et al., Energies 18(5) 1255, 2025, eq. (1): KPI = P[kW] / E[kWh] x 8760
_S1_legend.P=gse24pv-all: installed photovoltaic capacity, GSE Rapporto Statistico Solare Fotovoltaico 2024, Tavola 5, by province. PHOTOVOLTAIC ONLY and UNFILTERED BY PLANT SIZE: Dimovski sums generators <= 6 MW and GSE's class edges do not fall on 6 MW, so no exact filter is available from that table.
_S1_legend.E=terna24dom+ser: domestico + servizi consumption, Terna Dati Statistici sull'Energia Elettrica in Italia 2024, Tabella 45, by province. industria and agricoltura excluded as the KPI requires; servizi is net of FS railway traction per Terna's own footnote.
_S1_legend.X=prov>sub:uniform: GRANULARITY CROSSING, declared: the KPI is computed at province and carried to every substation in that province UNIFORMLY. There is NO ALLOCATOR, because both terms are published at province and neither is disaggregated.
_S1_legend.vintage: both terms are 2024, so there is no time crossing
_S1_legend.normalisation: Method B, soft_clip((KPI - P5)/(P95 - P5)) over italy's own fleet, record-weighted. The Dimovski breakpoints 1.29 / 7.78 are NOT used — see doctrine/RESULT_dimovski_read_the_breakpoints_cannot_travel.md
_S1_legend.component: S is NOT emitted. S = S1 0.75 + S2 0.125 + S3 0.125 and a letter is emitted only when every metric feeding it is present; S2 and S3 have no inputs anywhere in the estate.
_S1_legend.absent: a record with no province carries no S1 — absent, not zero

_provenance_legend.order: C V I E S T
_provenance_legend.a: absent — the component key is not on the record
_provenance_legend.L: linked — the record carries a per-component source for this component. AMENDED 2 October 2026: the source now OUTRANKS the value. Before, a declared source was overruled whenever the value happened to equal a generator's output or to be zero, which it did on 121 positions across eleven jurisdictions.
_provenance_legend.u: UNLINKED — reproduces neither generator AND carries no source. NOT the same as derived.
_provenance_legend._cprov_coincidence: present only where a position is L AND the value would also have reproduced a generator, or is zero. The component letters, in C V I E S T order. A seventh marker symbol was considered and refused: every consumer of _cprov would have had to learn it, and the fact is rarer than one record in five thousand.

_composite_coverage_legend: Convention #21. The summed COMPONENT_WEIGHTS of the components whose _cprov slot reads L — that is, the components carrying a RECORDED SOURCE. It is not a count of components derived from a measurement; a source string is a provenance claim and not a measurement claim, and the two were conflated in this field's original definition. A completeness claim, NOT a truth claim: a record may read high and still be substantially a hash of its own name. Presenting coverage as a quality score is banned. The separation of presence, provenance and derivation is before the flag officer in doctrine/AMENDMENT_20261001_convention_21_the_three_coverages.md

_re_norm_basis_legend.what: which normalisation basis this record's published Re_norm reproduces from. It declares the basis and changes no value.
_re_norm_basis_legend.D: the declared NEUTRAL DEFAULT: Re_raw 1.0 and Re_norm 0.0
_re_norm_basis_legend.G: reproduces from the DECLARED GLOBAL bounds clip((Re_raw-0.920)/(1.787-0.920),0,1)
_re_norm_basis_legend.C: reproduces from THIS FLEET'S OWN bounds, stated below
_re_norm_basis_legend.U: UNRESOLVED: reproduces from neither. NOT the same as wrong - no claim is made here that the stored value is incorrect, only that the basis it was computed against is not one this instrument can identify.
_re_norm_basis_legend.scoring: NO scoring field is written. Re_norm itself is untouched. The instrument diffs every scoring field on every record against what it read and exits 3 if any moved.
_re_norm_basis_legend.why: The estate declares one formula and at least three are in production: 8 fleets wholly on the declared bounds, 4 wholly on their own, 27 mixed within themselves, and 8.9 per cent of 619,171 non-default records reproducing from neither. Which basis the axis SHOULD use is a ruling, not a repair; this makes the answer readable in the meantime.
